text: 1、市场早间高开高走，科创50指数涨近4%。半导体芯片股延续涨势，托伦斯、华天科技、诚邦股份、博通集成等多股涨停。美容护理、服装、零售等消费股拉升，水羊股份、七匹狼、华纺股份、国芳集团等涨停。CPO、PCB等算力硬件股走强，共进股份、天津普林、大亚圣象等涨停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市近4600股飘红，上午半天成交1.33万亿。午间收盘沪指涨1.04%，深成指涨1.52%，创业板涨2.11%。 2、板块概念方面，半导体芯片、大消费、算力硬件、医药医疗等板块领涨；汽车整车、煤炭、养殖、银行等板块逆势下跌。 3、两市共4259只个股上涨，64只个股涨停；771
text_en: 1. The market opened higher and moved higher in the morning, with the STAR 50 Index rising nearly 4%. Semiconductor chip stocks extended their gains, with Torrance, Huatian Technology, Chengbang Shares, Broadcom Integrated and many others hitting the daily limit. Consumer stocks such as beauty care, apparel and retail rallied, with Shuiyang Shares, Septwolves, Huafang Shares, Guofang Group and others hitting the daily limit. Computing power hardware stocks such as CPO and PCB strengthened, with Gongjin Shares, Tianjin Printronics, DareGlobal and others hitting the daily limit. More stocks rose than fell, with nearly 4,600 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets trading higher, and turnover of 1.33 trillion yuan in the morning session. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 1.04%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.52%, and the ChiNext Index rose 2.11%. 2. In terms of sectors and themes, semiconductor chips, major consumption, computing power hardware, pharmaceuticals and healthcare led the gains; automobiles, coal, breeding and banking fell against the trend. 3.
